text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove! Um, thank you for the
present. It
arrived at the dorm this
morning.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I hope you didn't mind receiving running
wear
again this year. I thought about
getting
something else, but nothing felt
right.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, I really love it. When I run in
something new,
it feels especially good.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
What's more, you always pick the nicest
running
wear. It's comfy and
breathable—absolutely
perfect.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little embarrassed to get that much
praise,
but... so long as you like it, I'm
glad.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Good... Though I was wondering, can I
ask for one
more present?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm? Sure, let me hear it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well, the new clothes are great... but I'd
like to
wear them while running with you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I want to run with you as much as I can...
Is that
okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's easy enough! I'll schedule
time
between my student council duties.
